nusmp.skill.grimoire_chain.description: Grimoire magic: Chain Magic. The mage conjures iron chains out of the grimoire to bind, drag and cage foes, and tips them with kunai, weights and snake heads. Its pages whip and hook enemies in, pierce them with barbed chains, slam a weighted chain down, haul you across the field, wrap you in a guard of chains and wrap your fists in iron, then raise the Chain Cage and the Magic Binding Iron Chain Formation that holds a target still and silences its magic, and a daily Chain Reckoning that drains everyone near. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_chain.description: The grimoire of Chain Magic: twelve pages of conjured chains. Starters strike, whip and hook; mid pages unleash the viper chains, kunai chains and a heavy weighted chain, grapple you across the field, guard you with circling chains and armour your fists; the zone page cages an area; the signature binds a target and seals its magic; the daily drains and heals. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.page.book_chain.chain_strike: A single iron chain, tip sharpened like a spear, leaps from the open grimoire. It flies 14 blocks at speed 1.6 and pierces every enemy on its line for 8 damage, scaled by Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_chain.chain_whip: The chain cracks like a whip, and what it catches does not get away. Sweeps a wide arc up to 6.5 blocks ahead for 7 damage, drags every hit enemy toward you and slows it (Slowness II) for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_chain.scorpio_chain: A barbed chain curls like a scorpion tail before it stabs. Hooks the target within 18 blocks, reels it toward you (bosses barely move) and stings for 9 damage, Poison II for 4 seconds and Slowness II for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_chain.pitless_viper: Chains rise from every side, each ending in a hissing serpent head, and they strike one after another. Five strikes from five directions on one target within 20 blocks, 5 damage each with a little magicule bleed; the last bite adds Poison II for 5 seconds and Slowness III for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_chain.kunai_chains: Five kunai fly on five chains, each seeking its own prey. Fires a homing volley of five chains for 5 damage each; every hit bleeds 2 percent of the target's magicules and slows it (Slowness II) for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_chain.heavy_chain: A chain with an iron weight at its end is swung overhead and let go. It lands at the aimed point (up to 20 blocks) after 8 ticks and crushes everything within 3.5 blocks for 13 damage, slams them to the ground, and weighs them down with Slowness IV and Burden for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_chain.grapple_chain: A hooked chain bites into stone or flesh and reels the mage after it. Anchors on the block or enemy you aim at (3 to 28 blocks) and pulls you across at up to 2.6 blocks per tick, with Slow Falling for 2.5 seconds; if it hooked an enemy it also hits it for 5 damage and slows it.
nusmp.page.book_chain.chain_aegis: Chains circle the mage like a living ring of iron, lashing out at anything that gets close. For 8 seconds you gain Resistance II, enemies within 3.5 blocks take 3 damage every half second and are slowed (Slowness III), and enemy projectiles in the ring are torn from the air.
nusmp.page.book_chain.chain_armament: Chains wind round both arms down to the knuckles and the fists hit like wrecking weights. For 20 seconds your melee hits deal 3.5 extra damage, attackers take thorns damage, and you gain Resistance I.
nusmp.page.book_chain.chain_cage: The ground splits and a ring of chains rises, closing over the area like the bars of a cage. For 5 seconds (players 3 s, bosses 1 s) anything inside a 4.5 block radius that tries to leave is dragged back, is slowed (Slowness III) and takes 3 damage every second. Uses the shared control lock.
nusmp.page.book_chain.iron_chain_formati: Chains spiral round the target's torso and the arrow-tipped ends drive into the ground around it. The target within 18 blocks is rooted (Slowness X) for up to 7 seconds, Weakened, silenced and its skills are jammed (players cannot cast grimoire spells), takes 10 damage, and every second loses some magicules (to you) and aura. Bosses are held for 1 second. Uses the shared control lock.
nusmp.page.book_chain.chain_reckoning: Every chain the mage has ever made answers at once. Chains run through up to six enemies within 12 blocks for 8 damage each, slow them (Slowness IV) for 5 seconds, take 8 percent of their magicules and burn 10 percent of their aura, and mend you for each one. Once per 5 minutes.
